insertions.anchor: # Gateway must-deliver notes (auto-reset note, first-contact intro,
insertions.source:
# MantleOS direct nerve: committed user turn and Primer-first AppAI context.
    agent._mantle_addressed = isinstance(original_user_message, str) and original_user_message.lstrip().lower().startswith("@appai")
    try:
        from mantle.nerves import before_mind as _mantle_before_mind
        _mantle_turn = _mantle_before_mind(
            user_message=original_user_message,
            session_id=agent.session_id or "",
            turn_id=turn_id,
            surface=getattr(agent, "platform", None) or "",
        )
        _mantle_context = _mantle_turn.get("context", "")
        if _mantle_context:
            plugin_user_context = (
                _mantle_context + "\n\n" + plugin_user_context
                if plugin_user_context
                else _mantle_context
            )
    except Exception:
        logger.debug("Mantle committed-turn nerve unavailable", exc_info=True)

# MantleOS direct afferent nerve: one terminal semantic tool event.
    try:
        from mantle.nerves import tool_completed as _mantle_tool_completed
        _mantle_tool_completed(
            tool_name=function_name,
            arguments=function_args,
            status=status or ("failed" if error_type else "completed"),
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            session_id=getattr(agent, "session_id", "") or "",
            turn_id=getattr(agent, "_current_turn_id", "") or "",
        )
    except Exception:
        logger.debug("Mantle tool nerve unavailable", exc_info=True)

# MantleOS direct afferent nerve: completed turn boundary.
    try:
        from mantle.nerves import turn_ended as _mantle_turn_ended
        _mantle_turn_ended(
            session_id=agent.session_id or "",
            turn_id=turn_id,
            completed=completed,
            failed=failed,
            interrupted=interrupted,
        )
    except Exception:
        logger.debug("Mantle turn-end nerve unavailable", exc_info=True)
